notes: All Amazon.in selling fees on the official page are displayed excluding GST; Amazon then applies 18% GST on those fees (NOTE 1 on the source page).

Effective 16 Mar 2026, referral is 0% on most categories for item price <= ₹1000 (1800+ categories). Some electronics-accessory bands still charge below ₹1000 (e.g. Accessories - Electronics, PC and Wireless: 5% between ₹300 and ₹1000).

Scout 'Home & Kitchen' maps to official 'Kitchen - Other Products' (12.5% above ₹1000). Official 'Home - other products' is 18% above ₹1000 (décor / non-kitchen); use category_key home_other for that.
Scout 'Baby Products' maps to official 'Baby - Other Products' (7.5% above ₹1000), NOT 'Apparel - Baby' (7% above ₹1000).
other_default is a conservative catch-all for unmapped scout categories, NOT an Amazon fee category: 0% <= ₹1000, 12% above.

Remaining gaps: Amazon STEP program discounts are not modeled; volumetric weight (L×B×H/5000 vs actual) is not modeled (we use weight_grams only); FC closing-fee category groups (#, ##, A, B, C, D) are not published as a complete matrix; GetMyFeesEstimate / SP-API Product Fees API is not wired.
_meta.closing_fee_notes: Amazon does not publish a complete closing-fee matrix on the public page — only worked examples plus FC group snippets. Easy Ship <=300 = ₹1 and <=500 = ₹22 are official (sandals ₹299 → ₹1, ₹450 → ₹22). Self Ship <=300 = ₹20 and <=500 = ₹26 are official (Facewash ₹299 → ₹20, Shirts ₹499 → ₹26) and match March 2026 notes. Bands above ₹500 for Easy Ship and Self Ship are undocumented approximations (₹40 to ₹1000, ₹60 above). FBA/FC closing is a documented midpoint/default across unpublished groups: <=300 ₹20 (groups are ₹13/₹20/₹26), <=500 ₹18 (groups are ₹14/₹18/₹22), <=1000 ₹40 (unverified), >1000 ₹72 (page: 'above INR 1,000, ₹72 closing fee applies to select fee categories'). Do not treat FBA closing as a precise group lookup.
_meta.weight_handling_notes: Official Easy Ship example is ₹55 for a 350g headphone, which does not match this file's older local/regional/national 29/43/63 first-500g table. Size-guidelines example (800g regional = ₹68 = ₹51+₹17) also disagrees. The public page's zone slab card is not a complete published matrix (widgets). Existing slab numbers are kept as a pre-March-16 working approximation. Forum: ₹10 Easy Ship weight-handling reduction when sell_price <= ₹300 (easy_ship_under_300_weight_discount_rupees).

weight_handling_fee_easy_ship.note: Zone = Local (same city) / Regional (same region, different city) / National (cross-region). Slabs below may be pre-March-16; official public examples (₹55 for 350g headphone Easy Ship; 800g regional = ₹68) do not match. See _meta.weight_handling_notes.

fba_pick_pack_fee_rupees.note: Official Pick & Pack (FC only): ₹17 standard up to 1kg, ₹5 each additional kg up to 5kg, ₹2 per additional 5kg thereafter. Heavy & Bulky ₹26 per unit. Source: sell.amazon.in/fees-and-pricing 2026-08-15.
